claims.quote: Described from 'Li Kiang, southern China', which presumably refers to the place of the same name near Nanning city, Guangxi Autonomous Region.

regions.name: Zhu Jiang
regions.quote: S. pulchra has been recorded from several other tributary drainages of the Zhu Jiang system including the Liu Jiang and Gui Jiang.

regions.name: Jiulang Jiang
regions.quote: There also exist records of this species from the unconnected Jiulang Jiang drainage in Fujian province which borders Guangdong to the east.
